title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta25

## Docked mower marker reliability

Fixed an issue where some mowers could remain invisible on the Map Card after Home Assistant or the integration restarted, even though the mower was correctly reported as parked or charging.

- Adjusted the initial dock-proximity validation to account for a small difference between the charging station's map reference point and the mower's reported parking position.
- Kept protection against old, distant location samples so the mower marker does not jump to a stale position at startup.
- Added regression tests for the affected docked position and for rejecting a distant cached position.

No changes to mower commands, gate-area logic, map geometry, settings or model state-code mappings. No Map Card update is required.

### Validation

The updated startup checks have regression coverage. Real-device results will be monitored during the beta.
